name: Z UpTime – Uptime Monitoring Node
author: zubbin

sections.description:
Z UpTime – Uptime Monitoring Node connects your WordPress site to the Zubbin platform so you can monitor uptime, site health, and connection status from one central dashboard.

After activation, the plugin can register your site with Zubbin, send heartbeat data, report useful WordPress environment details, and help keep your site connected to your monitoring account.

Use this plugin if you want to:

  • Connect a WordPress site to the Zubbin monitoring platform
  • Track uptime and heartbeat status from a central dashboard
  • Sync basic site and environment details
  • Manage connected sites more easily across multiple WordPress installs

Z UpTime – Uptime Monitoring Node is designed for site owners, developers, and agencies that want a lightweight WordPress connector for centralized monitoring.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the plugin settings page.
  4. Connect the site to your Zubbin account.
  5. Confirm the site appears in your Zubbin dashboard.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It connects a WordPress site to the Zubbin platform for uptime monitoring, heartbeat checks, and centralized site visibility.

How do I connect my site?

Activate the plugin, open its settings page, and follow the Zubbin connection steps.

Do I need a Zubbin account?

Yes. This plugin is a connector for the Zubbin monitoring platform.

Does this plugin replace my website hosting monitoring?

No. It is intended to connect your WordPress site to Zubbin so monitoring and site data can be managed centrally.
